description: This Java source file defines the DispatcherActor class, an Akka actor responsible for dispatching signals without entity IDs, handling search and command streams, and integrating with cluster pub/sub mechanisms within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: DispatcherActor
classes.description: An Akka actor that dispatches signals without entity IDs, manages search and command streams, and interacts with pub/sub within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: DispatcherActor.ImmutableDispatch
classes.description: Immutable inner class representing a dispatched message with sender and aggregator actor references.

methods.name: mapMessage
methods.description: Maps incoming WithDittoHeaders messages to ImmutableDispatch objects.

methods.name: createSink
methods.description: Creates the sink for handling dispatched messages, logging unhandled messages.

methods.name: getBufferSize
methods.description: Returns buffer size from enforcement configuration.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Factory method to create Props for DispatcherActor with or without pre-enforcer.

methods.name: createDispatchFlow
methods.description: Creates the Akka stream graph for dispatching search and retrieve commands.

methods.name: multiplexBy
methods.description: Creates a filter to multiplex messages by class type.

methods.name: searchActorSink
methods.description: Creates sink to send messages to search actor via pub/sub.

methods.name: thingsAggregatorSink
methods.description: Creates sink to send messages to the things aggregator actor.

methods.name: preEnforce
methods.description: Applies pre-enforcement logic asynchronously before forwarding messages.

methods.name: initActor
methods.description: Initializes actor, performs path sanity check, and registers with pub/sub mediator.

methods.name: sanityCheck
methods.description: Verifies actor path matches expected dispatcher actor path.

methods.name: putSelfToPubSubMediator
methods.description: Registers this actor with the pub/sub mediator.
